scope.method: Every non-OS file assigned through explicit filename/family rules expanded to standalone entries. Asset selectors distinguish sheet/variable subsets. Scientific analytical outputs without a described row are unmatched_data; scripts and sidecars are not scientific asset matches. No study code executed or source file modified.

rows.evidence: Two workbooks directly contain the described carbon loss and accumulation compilation: 208 loss and 214 accumulation records with RefID. A reference workbook links citations.
rows.limitations: There are 147 reference rows and 146 unique RefIDs, but RefID 96 identifies two different citations. Resolve this before citation joins; populated records differ from formatted used ranges. The row supplies units and citation context that are not all explicit in local headers.

assets.selector: Sheet1: RefID, GrowthRate, MaxAge, StandardisedAge, PercentageAt20yrs and uncertainty fields
Sheet1: RefID, AbsoluteCLoss, PercLossCompIntactFor, Cpool, forest/degradation and uncertainty fields

rows.evidence: Five CO2 text files provide 8,294 sample records at ALF/RBA/SAN/TAB/TEF during 2010-2018, with UTC times, sample coordinates, altitude and QC flags; local metadata cites the exact PANGAEA dataset.
rows.limitations: The description includes carbon monoxide; no CO concentration asset was identified. Sample records are not equivalent to 590 profiles and profile reconstruction remains unvalidated. The TAB-to-TEF replacement explains five file labels versus four contemporaneous sites. Manifest site/file mapping, ALF end date and nominal site coordinates are inconsistent. Rejection flags and the 23-token schema need handling.

rows.evidence: All 28 suitability CSVs were individually assigned: current species/group tables and future complete/migratory/sedentary tables for 245/585 and 2030/2050/2070/2090. Species-coded continuous suitability values and coordinate-enriched files match the substance of the row.
rows.limitations: Delivered format is tabular grids, not a supplied raster distribution map. Binary presence/absence and thresholds are not identified. Current CSVs use mixed delimiters and not all include explicit latitude/longitude. Paper baseline dates and scenario-year semantics require preservation separately from filenames.

rows.limitations: Raw network CSI fields are not proof of RCIsuit. Scripts reference generated output/compilado/062025_habitat_index_complete.csv and .shp, which are not in this package. Rows 10 and 11 overlap in metric/scenario meaning and may describe the same product family.

rows.limitations: Same overlapping product family as row 10; future and baseline setup must be reconciled before treating the rows as separate assets. Code availability does not mean outputs are already present or reproducible without additional setup.

rows.limitations: The barrier point dataset is an input, not the requested ranking. part_4 writes 062025_barrier_index_complete.csv and summary products absent locally; archive members do not supply them.

rows.evidence: rspb20220726_si_002.xlsx / Supplement Table 2_Year Trends_ contains 121 region-year rows with the exact landings/diversity/trait/economic metrics described. Metadata sheet defines variables.
rows.limitations: Delivered as a nonspatial table of six named regions, not a vector layer. Geometry needs a deliberate regional join. Source traits/common names are in the other workbook; raw regional annual taxon-landings CSVs referenced by code are not supplied.

rows.evidence: GEE scripts produce the 2020/2025 classifications and training/reference polygons are present. No final classification image is included among the 24 local files.
rows.limitations: Script3 expects classified2020/classified2025 Earth Engine assets under placeholder projects/username paths. The training GeoJSONs are not classified regional maps. Script2 incorporates a 2023-2025 SWIR predictor into its 2020-labelled model; temporal lineage needs clarification.

rows.evidence: An eCognition workflow workbook and training/reference data support the fine-scale classification methodology, but no PlanetScope image or final classified raster was found.
rows.limitations: The workbook is procedural documentation, not the requested map. Related field measurements and spectral summaries must not be substituted for the classification product.

rows.evidence: FieldPlot_data.xlsx / Tree Data and Cover contain ecological field measurements and Plot_ID; tree_stats.csv is a field-metric subset. There are 363 dated tree rows and 24 cover rows from 2025-08-25 to 2025-09-04.
rows.limitations: Sheet says 23 plots but local data have IDs 1-24. Field sheets have no coordinate columns. Training polygons do not establish a GPS point-to-Plot_ID join. Metadata records estimated heights for Plot_ID 6 and a units row beneath the Cover header.

assets.selector: Tree Data and Cover sheets; Metadata for units/caveats; exclude embedded illustrative photos as observations

rows.evidence: data_all_joined.csv contains total richness for seven biodiversity groups in 310 site records; data_rich_forest_sp.csv supplies forest-species richness. Taxon-by-transect tables are associated inputs.
rows.limitations: The sheet calls the environment coordinates lat/long; the actual fields are UTM_X/UTM_Y. UTM zone/datum and join-key consistency need validation. Survey years 2010/2011 come from the sheet rather than explicit dates in these tables.

rows.evidence: Carbon_all_PGM.txt, Carbon_all_STM.txt and data_all_joined.csv directly contain Aboveground_pool, Litter_pool, Dead_pool and Soil_pool_new keyed by transect.
rows.limitations: Site metrics are present, but survey-date/units provenance and coordinate CRS need reconciliation before spatial publication. UTM coordinates are not longitude/latitude.

rows.evidence: Soil_PGM.csv and Soil_STM.csv directly provide site-level pH, Nperc, P, K, Na, CaMg and Al; joined/environment tables provide soil-carbon metrics and supporting covariates.
rows.limitations: Raw five-point, depth-increment and intact-core bulk-density measurements described by the row were not identified. The available match is aggregated soil properties, not complete raw sampling records; UTM CRS is unresolved.

rows.evidence: TreeDensity.asc is the explicit ASCII raster export named in TreeDiversityScript.R for tree density, individuals per hectare; header cell size is approximately 0.1.
rows.limitations: CRS is absent in the ASCII header and no PRJ is supplied; degree-like values do not establish datum. Tree-diversity TIFF posters are figures, not alternate geospatial products. Observation period is unresolved.

rows.limitations: CRS is absent in the ASCII header and no PRJ is supplied; degree-like values do not establish datum. Tree-diversity TIFF posters are figures, not alternate geospatial products. Observation period is unresolved.

rows.evidence: TreeRichness_ha.asc is the explicit ASCII raster export named in TreeDiversityScript.R for tree richness per hectare; header cell size is approximately 0.1.
rows.limitations: CRS is absent in the ASCII header and no PRJ is supplied; degree-like values do not establish datum. Tree-diversity TIFF posters are figures, not alternate geospatial products. Observation period is unresolved.

rows.evidence: PlotData.csv provides 2,046 plot records with coordinates, metadata, density/diversity/richness and references. PlotsAbiotic.csv contains matching plot-keyed environmental covariates.
rows.limitations: year_est is establishment year, not demonstrated measurement date. Coordinate datum and citation parsing require clarification. Additional environmental values are supporting data rather than the gridded outputs.

rows.evidence: data_plot_PGM.csv and data_plot_STM.csv provide classifications for 117+98=215 plots, matching the plot universe. Individual census records were not found.
rows.limitations: The requested 25,313 large and 30,070 small tree measurements are absent from the supplied tables; diversity estimates and 72 diversity matrices are separate analytical products and are explicitly left unmatched. A candidate cross-study join matches 206/215 region+plot keys to LULC environment_all.txt; identity and UTM CRS remain unverified.

rows.evidence: No individual/species table containing the 20 named functional traits was found among the 96 files. Scripts and functional-diversity summaries demonstrate analysis of traits but do not supply the requested measurements.
rows.limitations: Functional-diversity average/dissimilarity matrices are not bark/leaf/chemical trait records and are recorded as unmatched scientific products. A potential plot-coordinate join cannot reconstruct missing trait values.

rows.evidence: NetworkDataPollinationNew.csv contains 5,201 species and 15 pollinator-group fields; Final_Query_Genera.csv provides 804 genus rows with pollinator fields. PollinationData.xlsx and the genus publication table provide underlying visitation records.
rows.limitations: Exact paper totals differ from simple local counts: genus source table has 6,868 rows with original count sum 13,989; Final_Query_Genera has 804 genera and Count_Pollination sum 6,336. Script applies count recoding/aggregation, so 14,076 genus and 9,619 species interactions require version/filter reconciliation. Bootstrap sampling-diversity outputs are not the described matrices.

assets.selector: Genus and pollinator-group columns; do not use Count_Pollination as the published interaction total without reconciliation

rows.evidence: NetworkDataPollinationNew.csv directly contains dispersal modes, seedmass and Fleshy for 5,201 species; R comments identify two dispersal-source blocks.
rows.limitations: Unassisted appears twice in separate source blocks; use column position plus source semantics. This is a nonspatial species trait table, not occurrence geometry.

assets.selector: species, seedmass, Fleshy and dispersal blocks; distinguish both Unassisted columns

rows.evidence: TMS_data.xlsx contains plotID, DateTime, Soil_temp, Surface_temp, Air_temp and volMoist; PooledData.xlsx contains plot-level means/minima/maxima and moisture.
rows.limitations: No distinct iButton series at 1.5 m was identified. Full large-workbook timestamp range/interval coverage was not exhaustively scanned, and only 25 pooled plots are present. Remote ECOSTRESS temperatures are a related source, not the described field-sensor measurements.
